provenance.source: Owner-validated Codex 0.156.1 catalog at /usr/bin/codex exposes gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol. Use Luna medium for economical delivery and Sol medium for infrequent independent supervision; Agent Manager's managed codec bypasses the Vrooli attribution shim and selects the installed system runner; Astra remains excluded.

caveats: Codex's native permission settings remain intent-only; Vrooli projects a PreToolUse hook, but hook firing requires a live canary on the installed Codex version.
